title: Apartamento T2 com 2 lugares de garagem para venda em Portimão
description:

Não deixe escapar esta oportunidade.

Excellent opportunity in premium location!

With east/south sun exposure, the flat benefits from excellent natural light.

The property consists of:

Entrance hall;

Large and equipped kitchen;

Balcony;

2 spacious bedrooms, one of them en suite and closet;

2 bathrooms;

2 parking spaces in the garage;

Collection.

Energy certification B.

The combination of location, generous areas, suite, balcony, 2 parking spaces and storage room makes this property a difficult opportunity to find in Portimão.
